Initial release of the Skill Base Web Server deployment guide.

- Provides step-by-step instructions for deploying and running the Skill Base server with npx or Docker.

- Details data directory structure and backup recommendations.
- Includes troubleshooting guidance on ports, connectivity, and permissions.
- Clarifies the distinction between this deployment guide and the client CLI (`skill-base-cli`).
